newsitem.title: USA: GE unit wins $200 mln Tower Air contract.
newsitem.headline: GE unit wins $200 mln Tower Air contract.

text.p: GE Engine Services Inc, a subsidiary of General Electric Co, said Tuesday it won a maintenance and overhaul contract valued at more than $200 million from Tower Air, a New York-based charter airline.

The five-year contract calls for the GE unit to maintain and refurbish United Technologies Corp Pratt & Whitney JT9 engines in Tower Air's 14 Boeing Co 747-100s and 747-200s. The company said GE Engine Services continues to experience rapid growth and has been awarded multi-year contracts valued at more than $4 billion during the first nine months of 1996.
